sensor: 1/2.78" progressive scan RGB CMOS, 2.0 µm pixel
features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F91 Main Unit (F9111, F9111-R Mk II, F9114, F9114-R Mk II, F9114-B Mk II, F9104-B Mk II); power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
5 MP (2592x1944) up to 30/25 fps, Quad HD up to 60/50 fps with AXIS F9111
Rugged sensor (NEMA 4X, IEC 61373) with SMA connector for vehicles and machinery
M12 lens mount, fixed IR-cut filter
Can be combined with up to three other sensor units on one main unit
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f2107-re-standard-sensor-en-US-482146.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded. consumption_w is the sensor unit's own max draw per datasheet.
